breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to 'Calculate the density of liquid water at 20°C and 1 atm using the ideal gas law,' which directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires treating liquid water as incompressible with rho ≈ 998 kg/m³ and explicitly states NOT to use the ideal-gas law for a liquid. The agent failed to identify and correct this fundamental physical inconsistency.
